description:
Deposit the token-B side (STX or USDCx depending on market) into the current Jingswap auction cycle. Only works during the deposit phase. Amount is in human units (e.g. 10 for 10 STX, or 10 for 10 USDCx).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount of token B to deposit (human units)
